SELECT count(*) AS total, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN d.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unresolved_document, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unresolved_project FROM chunk_embeddings c LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.id = c.document_id AND d.organization_id = c.organization_id AND d.project_id = c.project_id LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = c.project_id AND p.organization_id = c.organization_id
SELECT count(DISTINCT document_id) AS count FROM chunk_embeddings
